title: Effects of an ARCS-based interactive e-book featuring clinical scenarios on the learning motivation, self-efficacy and practical competence of nursing students in foetal heart rate interpretation
reason: Randomised controlled trial (e-book vs instructional video) comparing learning motivation, self-efficacy and foetal-heart-rate interpretation scores with GEE. Only group contrasts; no per-student e-book usage indicator or activity product enters any analysis.

extraction.country: Taiwan (Asia Eastern University of Science and Technology)
extraction.n_quote: study, so 80 participants were included in the data analysis including 41
extraction.outcome_or_construct: learning motivation, self-efficacy (self-report); FHR interpretation competence
extraction.notes: Experimental n = 41, control n = 39. Secondary code: NOREL.
